execution_anchor: T_exec = first executable open after all required sources are available
native_kline_availability: close timestamp of the completed native 15m kline
derived_bucket_availability: maximum close timestamp of all complete constituent native 15m klines
rest_snapshot_availability: corrected_response_receipt_time, else response_received_at; latest finite record strictly before T_exec, tie-broken by source_identity
forceOrder_event_boundary: exchange_event_time from the normalized envelope (payload E); order T/t is descriptive only
forceOrder_source_availability: corrected_response_receipt_time, else collector_receipt_time; must be strictly before T_exec
forceOrder_execution_anchor: smallest scheduled executable open strictly after exchange_event_time and satisfying source_available_time < T_exec
finite_rule: all timestamps and numeric inputs must be finite; missing, non-finite, or exact-boundary values are ineligible
bootstrap_rule: fit the restricted null model, multiply complete-block residuals by Rademacher draws, retain original studentization, inclusive absolute tail (1+exceedances)/(10000+1)
degeneracy_rule: reject the hypothesis observation set if the tested design rank is below its declared rank, any required cell is absent, or robust variance is non-positive

H01.endpoint_semantics: close of the single completed native 15m bar immediately following T_exec

H02.endpoint_semantics: endpoint requires four complete native 15m closes through T_exec+60m

H03.endpoint_semantics: immediate post-event closed 15m response for a candidate forceOrder identity whose event boundary and receipt pass the strict rule

H04.endpoint_semantics: incremental delayed response after the H03 endpoint; candidate identity is retained but H04 requires both +15m and +60m endpoints

H05.endpoint_semantics: one-hour closed-kline response with funding and premium sources available before T_exec

H06.endpoint_semantics: one-hour closed-kline response with oriented BTC/breadth context fixed at T_exec
